item.title: Building a Break-Even Calculator in Google Sheets: Contribution Margin and a What-If Table
item.description:
Break-even analysis answers one question: how many units before revenue covers fixed costs. Building it in a spreadsheet instead of running the math once means you can change any input, price, cost per unit, fixed overhead, and see the break-even point move immediately. Nothing here is pricing or business strategy advice. Just the calculator and how to read it.
